no_fertigation: Aaj fertigation ki zarurat nahi hai.
no_irrigation: Aaj irrigation ki zarurat nahi hai.
barren_no_spray: Bina zarurat ke beej bounay se pehle khali mitti par pre-emergence spray nahi lagana chahiye.
barren_spray_rain_delay: Barish ka bhavishya — herbicide/stubble treatment ko tab tak talna jab tak khet sukh nahi jata.
barren_spray_consider: Beej bounay se pehle khali khet par weed/stubble management par vichar karo (crop foliar spray nahi).
barren_spray_hint: Agar bhari weeds ya stubble hai: sujhaav diya gaya pre-sowing herbicide istemal karo ya mechanical tareeke se hatao. Barish ke 48 ghante ke andar spray se bacho.
barren_fert_plan: Basal fertilizer beej bounay se pehle ya us samay lagana chahiye. Yojit {crop} ke liye matra tayar karo.
barren_fert_active: Beej bounay ka samay chalu hai — {crop} ke liye basal dose tayar karo aur lagao.
barren_irr_ok: Zameen ki nami beej bounay ki tayyari ke liye paryapt hai. Beej bounay se pehle paani bharne se bacho.
barren_irr_dry_optional: Zameen ki nami kam hai lekin abhi beej bounay ka saptah nahi hai — antim tillage se pehle halka irrigation optional hai.
barren_irr_pre_sowing_only: Beej bounay ke liye irrigation tabhi karo jab beej bounay ki gehraai par seedbed sukh jaye.
barren_irr_rain_hold: Is saptah barish ki sambhavana hai — drainage confirm hone tak irrigation mat karo.
barren_irr_dry_sow: Beej bounay se pehle zameen sukh gayi hai — beej ki gehraai tak nami lane ke liye halka pre-sowing irrigation karo.
barren_irr_light: Beej bounay se 2–4 din pehle ek halka irrigation (ya furrow sowing ho to bhigo do). Barish hone par rok do.
barren_monitoring: Weed pressure, 10–15 cm par zameen ki nami, aur khet ki samanta check karo. Beej bounay ki expected tareekh ko beej bounay ke baad update karo.
barren_sowing_passed: Expected beej bounay ki tareekh guzar gayi hai. Beej bounay se pehle zameen ki nami aur variety window ko punah mulyankan karo.
barren_heavy_rain: Agale 3 dinon mein bhari barish ki sambhavana hai. Antim zameen ki tayyari aur beej bounay ko tab tak talna jab tak topsoil drain nahi hota.
barren_heat: Bahut uncha taapmaan bhavishya mein hai. Shaam ko beej bounay ko pasand karo ya thande samay ka intezaar karo.
barren_rain_sowing_week: Beej bounay ke saptah mein madhyam barish. Ab prathmik tillage pura karo; barish saaf hone ke baad beej bouno.
barren_dry_window: Aage ka samay relatively sukhha hai — zameen ko level karne, antim tillage, aur basal fertilizer ko milane ke liye accha hai.
barren_monitor_weekly: Har saptah bhavishya ko monitor karo. Beej bounay ke saptah se pehle gehri jhoonkar aur residue management pura karo.
weather_days_note_future: Expected beej bounay mein {days} din hain.
weather_days_note_overdue: Beej bounay ki tareekh {days} din pehle thi — update karo ya jald beej bouno.
weather_message: Mausam: {temp}. Agle 3 din barish ~{rain3} mm, 7 din ~{rain7} mm.{daysNote} {reason}
crop_risk_cause_delayed: yojana ke mukabale mein der se beej bounana
crop_risk_cause_heavy_rain: beej bounay se pehle bhari barish
crop_risk_cause_wet_soil: zameen beej bounay ke liye bahut nami hai
crop_risk_action_high: Beej bounay ki tareekh ya variety window ko samayojit karo; paani bhari zameen mein beej mat bouno.
crop_risk_action_low: Beej bounay ke saptah ke nazdeek zameen ki tayyari checklist ka palan karo aur bhavishya ko rozana monitor karo.
carbon_prefix_no_crop: Abhi tak koi crop carbon uptake nahi hai.
carbon_note_organic: Beej bounay se pehle: organic matter aur lambey samay ke carbon capture ko sudharne ke liye compost/FYM daalo.
carbon_note_conventional: Pehle crop cycle se residue retention aur prabhavi fertilizer istemal ki yojana banao.
phase_overdue: Beej bounay ki tareekh guzar gayi
plant_growth_description: Koi khada crop nahi hai. {crop} ({variety}) ke liye tayyari kar rahe hain. Expected beej bounay: {date}.
crop_health_recommendation: Khali khet — zameen mein koi crop nahi. {crop} ke liye pre-sowing checklist ka palan karo. {reason}
yield_explanation: Standard yield = crop profile benchmark (per hectare) x farm area. AI yield isse growth, health, greenness, water, aur nutrients ka istemal karke adjust karta hai.
yield_explanation_short: Standard = crop profile benchmark × farm area. AI growth, health, temperature, water, aur soil fertility ka istemal karke adjust karta hai.
yield_skipped_maturity: Yield estimate sirf maturity/harvest stage par dikhaya jata hai.
yield_skipped_barren: Yield estimate sirf tab dikhaya jata hai jab crop beej boun diya gaya ho.
